claims.text: Support analysts need an assistant that answers product questions from our knowledge.
The assistant must keep reviewable conversation history.
The application must be deployable to a local deploy target.
The application must let a support analyst chat with an assistant that answers from our product knowledge.
Analysts should be able to review past conversations to reuse good answers.
The assistant must identify itself clearly so customers know it is automated.
Conversation records need to be stored for quality review.
The future process should route each question to the assistant first.
The analyst must approve the reply before it is sent.
